Imports

core, policy

Types

Filesystem = ref object
The Filesystem type provides a multi-disk abstraction where you can define multiple "disks" (storage backends) and perform file operations on them using a unified interface. A PolicyRules can be attached to each disk to enforce a security layer.

proc addDisk(fs: Filesystem; name: string; driver: StorageDriver;
             policy: PolicyRules) {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Adds a new disk (storage backend) to the Filesystem, enforcing the given policy on every operation. The name is used to reference this disk in file operations.

proc disk(fs: Filesystem; name = ""): StorageDriver {.

Retrieves a StorageDriver for the specified disk name. If no name is provided, it returns the default disk. When a policy is attached to the disk, a FilesystemPolicy wrapper enforcing it is returned.

template parseCsv(fs: Filesystem; path: string)

Convenience method to read and parse a CSV file from the default disk.

This template requires openparser/csv to be imported in the caller module to work.
